answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 12191 Country: India Title: Can wealthy children pay Fidya for Salat of a dead father who missed some Salat in his life? Is it obligatory or not? Question: Can wealthy children pay Fidya for Salat of a dead father who missed some Salat in his life? Is it obligatory or not? Answer ID: 12191 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 642/456=L/1430) Yes, they can give the fidyah (expiation). The amount of fidyah of one salah is 1.633 kg wheat or its price. While giving fidyah , witr also should be counted with the five salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
